verdict.rationale: Firebase documents its own bulk mechanisms: Cloud Firestore advertises atomic batch operations, and the official firebase-tools CLI supports bulk import/export of Auth users. However, the evidence is a single brief mention each, with no detail on batch size limits, bulk update/delete workflows, or bulk actions through the MCP server or AI tooling. Missing for 10: documented batch limits and semantics, bulk operations exposed to AI agents via MCP/CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: atomic batch operations, and ACID transaction support
